simple.meaning: גִּיל (gîyl) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a revolution (of time, i.e. an age); also joy.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 11 times in Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 3 more, beginning at Job 3:22. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, flock, altar, righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גִּיל (H1524) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גִּיל (gîyl) / H1524 is traced through Job 3:22, Psalms 43:4, Psalms 45:16, Psalms 65:13 with source-language evidence and verse context.

structuredEvidence.definition: a revolution (of time, i.e. an age); also joy

timeline.evidenceText: Then I will go to the altar of God,
Your sons will take the place of your fathers.
The pastures are covered with flocks.
The father of the righteous has great joy.
The father of the righteous has great joy.

Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.
Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field

The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”
Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations;
Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes;

definitions.usage: × exceedingly, gladness, × greatly, joy, rejoice(-ing), sort.
definitions.full: H1524. giyl I. גִּיל noun [masculine] rejoicing — Job 3:22 6 t., גִּו֯ל Prov 23:24 ; suffix גִּילִי Psa 43:4 ; — rejoicing 65:13 ; Prov 23:24 ; || שׂמחה Psa 45:16 ; Isa 16:10 ; Jer 48:33 ; Joel 1:16 , גִילִי שִׂמְחַת Psa 43:4 , גיל אל שׂמח glad unto rejoicing Hosea 9:1 ; Job 3:22 . II. [ גִּיל ] noun [masculine] circle, age , גִלְכֶם כְּ אשׁר הילדים מן of the youths which are of your age Dan 1:10 (compare Arabic Samaritan גיל = Hebrew דור = γενεά , Talmud גילו בן one born at the same time, a contemporary ).
